lines: I dream a lot, so my project is about dream recall. Think of a little Zhou Gong living by your bed.
Papi, our night agent, wakes the sleeper about five times less often than last week's version.
Fun fact: doing nothing scored 0.71 on my eval. That's why I read results by night type, not one average.
Glance was my week 2 build: press a key, ask out loud, and it explains the line of code you're stuck on.
The agent asks for volume 20, reads back 35 because someone pressed the speaker's button, and decides again.
I'm lazy about tagging my Obsidian notes, so week 1 I built an agent to link them for me.
